content:
{
  "background": {
    "type": "photographic",
    "id": "photo_base",
    "description": "雨天撑伞视角的连续摄影底图，包含雨滴、伞骨、伞下地面及鞋子，完整显示区域延伸至画布四边；上层照片、文字和装饰遮挡局部，保留摄影环境。"
  },
  "objects": [
    {
      "id": "photo_top_right",
      "kind": "photo",
      "bbox": [
        650,
        80,
        900,
        240
      ],
      "description": "右上角绿色树叶特写照片，保留树叶及背景，左上角有米色胶带装饰。"
    },
    {
      "id": "photo_bottom_left",
      "kind": "photo",
      "bbox": [
        70,
        750,
        320,
        920
      ],
      "description": "左下角雨滴特写照片，保留雨滴及背景，四周有白色胶带装饰。"
    },
    {
      "id": "overlay_four_leaf",
      "kind": "overlay",
      "bbox": [
        750,
        320,
        850,
        420
      ],
      "description": "绿色四叶草贴纸，中心有白色卡通形象，位于文字框右上方。"
    },
    {
      "id": "text_cn",
      "kind": "text",
      "bbox": [
        200,
        420,
        500,
        520
      ],
      "text": "消失的下雨天，\n我好想再淋一遍。",
      "color": "#000000",
      "font": "serif",
      "align": "left",
      "bold": false,
      "italic": false
    },
    {
      "id": "text_en",
      "kind": "text",
      "bbox": [
        500,
        600,
        900,
        650
      ],
      "text": "Disappearing rainy days,\nI want to get wet for another day.",
      "color": "#FFFFFF",
      "font": "sans",
      "align": "left",
      "bold": false,
      "italic": false
    },
    {
      "id": "text_rainy",
      "kind": "text",
      "bbox": [
        130,
        780,
        250,
        820
      ],
      "text": "Rainy",
      "color": "#FFFFFF",
      "font": "sans",
      "align": "center",
      "bold": false,
      "italic": false
    },
    {
      "id": "overlay_drops",
      "kind": "overlay",
      "bbox": [
        400,
        700,
        950,
        850
      ],
      "description": "白色水滴装饰，分布在照片下方区域，独立于摄影内容。"
    }
  ],
  "layer_order": [
    "photo_base",
    "photo_top_right",
    "photo_bottom_left",
    "overlay_four_leaf",
    "text_cn",
    "text_en",
    "text_rainy",
    "overlay_drops"
  ]
}
